SELECT a.cert_id, a.awarded_at, a.emp_id AS employee_id, e.emp_name AS employee_name, p.target_skill, p.career_goal, p.path_id,
       (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(hours), 0) FROM path_items WHERE path_id = p.path_id) AS total_hours,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM path_items WHERE path_id = p.path_id) AS items
FROM awards a
JOIN learning_paths p ON p.path_id = a.path_id
JOIN employees e ON UPPER(e.emp_id) = a.emp_id
WHERE a.award = 'certificate' AND a.cert_id = TRIM($1::text);

WITH e AS (
  SELECT emp_id, emp_name, emp_dept, emp_role, slack_user_id
  FROM employees
  WHERE UPPER(emp_id) = UPPER(TRIM($1::text)) AND LOWER(TRIM(emp_name)) = LOWER(TRIM($2::text))
  LIMIT 1),
u AS (
  UPDATE employees SET slack_user_id = NULLIF(TRIM($3::text), '')
  WHERE NULLIF(TRIM($3::text), '') IS NOT NULL AND emp_id IN (SELECT emp_id FROM e)
  RETURNING slack_user_id)
SELECT UPPER(e.emp_id) AS employee_id, e.emp_name AS full_name, e.emp_role AS role, e.emp_dept AS department,
       COALESCE((SELECT slack_user_id FROM u LIMIT 1), e.slack_user_id) AS slack_user_id
FROM e;

WITH p AS (
  SELECT * FROM learning_paths
  WHERE emp_id = UPPER(TRIM($1::text)) AND status IN ('active','completed')
  ORDER BY (status = 'active') DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT
  (SELECT row_to_json(p) FROM p) AS path,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(i ORDER BY i.week_no, i.seq) FROM path_items i JOIN p ON i.path_id = p.path_id), '[]'::json) AS items,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(a ORDER BY a.awarded_at) FROM awards a JOIN p ON a.path_id = p.path_id), '[]'::json) AS awards,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(f) FROM (SELECT rating, comment, source, created_at FROM feedback
            WHERE emp_id = UPPER(TRIM($1::text)) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10) f), '[]'::json) AS feedback;

WITH p AS (
  INSERT INTO learning_paths (emp_id, status, target_skill, career_goal, current_skill, learning_style, target_proficiency,
    experience_years, experience_band, weekly_hours, summary, skill_gap_analysis, coverage_note, personalization_notes,
    assessment, parent_path_id, version)
  VALUES (UPPER(TRIM($1::text)), 'active', $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, NULLIF($7::text, '')::numeric, $8, $9::numeric, $10, $11, $12, $13,
    $14::jsonb, NULLIF($15::text, '')::bigint, $16::int)
  RETURNING path_id, created_at),
i AS (
  INSERT INTO path_items (path_id, content_id, week_no, end_week, seq, skill, topic, level, format, hours, provider, cost, url, rationale, status, completed_at)
  SELECT p.path_id, x.content_id, x.week_no, x.end_week, x.seq, x.skill, x.topic, x.level, x.format, x.hours, x.provider, x.cost, x.url, x.rationale, x.status, x.completed_at
  FROM p, jsonb_to_recordset($17::jsonb) AS x(content_id text, week_no int, end_week int, seq int, skill text, topic text, level text, format text,
       hours numeric, provider text, cost text, url text, rationale text, status text, completed_at timestamptz)
  RETURNING 1),
a AS (
  INSERT INTO awards (path_id, emp_id, award, cert_id, awarded_at)
  SELECT p.path_id, aw.emp_id, aw.award, NULL, aw.awarded_at
  FROM p, awards aw
  WHERE $18::boolean AND aw.path_id = NULLIF($15::text, '')::bigint AND aw.award <> 'certificate'
  RETURNING 1)
SELECT p.path_id, p.created_at, (SELECT count(*) FROM i) AS item_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM a) AS carried_awards FROM p;

WITH p AS (
  SELECT path_id FROM learning_paths
  WHERE emp_id = UPPER(TRIM($1::text)) AND status = 'active' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1),
x AS (SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($2::jsonb) AS x(content_id text, done boolean)),
u AS (
  UPDATE path_items i
  SET status = CASE WHEN x.done THEN 'completed' ELSE 'pending' END,
      completed_at = CASE WHEN x.done THEN COALESCE(i.completed_at, now()) ELSE NULL END
  FROM p, x
  WHERE i.path_id = p.path_id AND UPPER(i.content_id) = UPPER(TRIM(x.content_id))
    AND i.status <> CASE WHEN x.done THEN 'completed' ELSE 'pending' END
  RETURNING i.content_id, i.status)
SELECT (SELECT path_id FROM p) AS path_id, COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(u) FROM u), '[]'::json) AS changed;

WITH p AS (
  SELECT * FROM learning_paths
  WHERE emp_id = UPPER(TRIM($1::text)) AND status IN ('active','completed')
  ORDER BY (status = 'active') DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT
  (SELECT row_to_json(p) FROM p) AS path,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(i ORDER BY i.week_no, i.seq) FROM path_items i JOIN p ON i.path_id = p.path_id), '[]'::json) AS items,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(a ORDER BY a.awarded_at) FROM awards a JOIN p ON a.path_id = p.path_id), '[]'::json) AS awards,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(f) FROM (SELECT rating, comment, source, created_at FROM feedback
            WHERE emp_id = UPPER(TRIM($1::text)) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10) f), '[]'::json) AS feedback;

WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO awards (path_id, emp_id, award, cert_id)
  SELECT $1::bigint, UPPER(TRIM($2::text)), x.award, x.cert_id
  FROM jsonb_to_recordset($3::jsonb) AS x(award text, cert_id text)
  ON CONFLICT (path_id, award) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING award, cert_id, awarded_at),
c AS (
  UPDATE learning_paths
  SET status = CASE WHEN $4::boolean THEN 'completed' ELSE status END,
      completed_at = CASE WHEN $4::boolean THEN COALESCE(completed_at, now()) ELSE completed_at END,
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE path_id = $1::bigint
  RETURNING status)
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(ins) FROM ins), '[]'::json) AS new_awards, (SELECT status FROM c) AS path_status;

  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(i ORDER BY i.week_no, i.seq) FROM path_items i WHERE i.path_id = p.path_id), '[]'::json) AS items,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(a) FROM awards a WHERE a.path_id = p.path_id), '[]'::json) AS awards
FROM learning_paths p
JOIN employees e ON UPPER(e.emp_id) = p.emp_id
WHERE p.status = 'active' AND COALESCE(e.slack_user_id, '') <> '';

parameters.content:
## Setup
1. Run `schema.sql` in Postgres.
2. Pinecone index: dimension **1536**, metric **cosine**. Paste its host into **Normalize Request** (CONFIG).
3. Credentials: Postgres, OpenAI, *Header Auth* for Pinecone (`Api-Key: <key>`) on the 6 Pinecone nodes, *Slack API* (bot token) on the 3 Slack post nodes.
4. Slack app: slash command `/learn` + Interactivity → `<n8n>/webhook/slack-learning`. Scopes: `chat:write`, `commands`, `im:write`. Edit **Parse Slack Request** (CONFIG).
5. App ➜ Admin tab ➜ *Sync content library* (embeds the CSV into Pinecone).

## Actions on /webhook/employee-assessment
`assess` · `status` · `progress` · `feedback` · `verify_certificate` · `ingest_library`

Assess: verify → existing-path check (keep / update / replace) → RAG retrieval (Pinecone) → experience-aware prompt → plan with prereq + hour-budget scheduler → Postgres + Pinecone → Slack.

Progress: update → badges at 25/50/75 % → certificate at 100 % → app + Slack.
